title: New Dance Banjo Moon
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 5 "neighbors balance & swing ( larks who cross over it in be partners, end swing facing on left diagonal · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 6 "slice left and straight back with neighbor" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line.
Row 7 "larks allemande left 1½" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 2 are too far apart to turn by the hand.

Row 8 "partners balance & swing end swing in wave of four, robins left in center right hand to partner, larks have to face in line of progression, the partners are facing the other way , larks slide out to take partners right hand, robins slide in to take the other robins left hand! · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 6 "slice left and straight back with neighbor" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.

Row 8 "partners balance & swing end swing in wave of four, robins left in center right hand to partner, larks have to face in line of progression, the partners are facing the other way , larks slide out to take partners right hand, robins slide in to take the other robins left hand! · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2's partner is outside the group.

Row 8 "partners balance & swing end swing in wave of four, robins left in center right hand to partner, larks have to face in line of progression, the partners are facing the other way , larks slide out to take partners right hand, robins slide in to take the other robins left hand! · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2's partner is outside the group.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
